National Certification Board for Therapeutic Massage & Bodywork
Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists
National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching

exams.name: Certified Ayurvedic Health Counselor
exams.body: National Ayurvedic Medical Association Certification Board
exams.blurb: Entry-level Ayurvedic credential examination covering diet, lifestyle counselling, doshas and preventive health practice.

exams.name: Certified Ayurvedic Practitioner
exams.body: National Ayurvedic Medical Association Certification Board
exams.blurb: Examination for Ayurvedic practitioners covering assessment, herbal formulation, panchakarma principles and client management.

exams.name: AAM Board Certification in Micropigmentation
exams.blurb: Written and practical board certification for permanent makeup and micropigmentation practitioners including medical tattoo work.

exams.name: Bloodborne Pathogens Training for Body Artists
exams.blurb: OSHA-aligned course on bloodborne pathogen exposure control, sterilisation and cross-contamination prevention for tattoo and piercing artists.

exams.name: Certified Permanent Cosmetics Professional
exams.blurb: Examination covering colour theory, skin anatomy, sterilisation and device handling for permanent cosmetic makeup artists.

exams.name: Certified Trichologist
exams.blurb: Programme and examination in hair and scalp science, diagnosis of hair loss disorders and non-medical treatment protocols.

exams.name: Prov Cosmetology Licensing Examination
exams.blurb: Test administration channel delivering NIC theory and remote practical beauty licensure examinations for many state boards.

exams.name: PSI Cosmetology Licensing Examination
exams.blurb: Umbrella testing programme delivering NIC and state-authored cosmetology, barbering and esthetics licensure examinations.

exams.name: ARCB Certified Reflexologist
exams.blurb: National examination and documentation review covering foot reflexology theory, technique, anatomy and professional practice.

exams.name: Board Certification in Therapeutic Massage and Bodywork
exams.body: National Certification Board for Therapeutic Massage & Bodywork
exams.blurb: Advanced voluntary credential above state licensure, requiring extra education, a background check and a board certification examination.

exams.name: Certified Nutrition Specialist
exams.body: Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists
exams.blurb: Graduate-level advanced nutrition credential requiring supervised practice hours and a examination in personalised clinical nutrition.

exams.name: Certified Sleep Science Coach
exams.blurb: Online programme and assessment on sleep physiology, circadian rhythm, sleep hygiene coaching and behaviour change strategies.

exams.name: Certified Wellness Practitioner
exams.blurb: Credential for wellness programme professionals covering multidimensional wellness models, planning, evaluation and ethics.

exams.name: Certified Yoga Therapist
exams.blurb: Credential for graduates of accredited yoga therapy programmes applying yoga practices to specific health conditions and populations.

exams.name: NANP Board Exam in Holistic Nutrition
exams.blurb: Board examination for holistic nutrition professionals covering whole-food nutrition, biochemistry, client education and scope of practice.

exams.name: National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach
exams.body: National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching
exams.blurb: Board examination delivered with the NBME covering coaching structure, health behaviour change theory and ethical practice.

exams.name: Registered Aromatherapist Examination
exams.blurb: National examination on essential oil chemistry, botany, safety and therapeutic application for practising aromatherapists.
